consensus.source: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Survey of Professional Forecasters, median of levels
consensus.terms: Public; quarterly survey medians as published, by survey quarter

factors.terms: Free for research; cite Fama and French

ff5-daily.description: Mkt-RF SMB HML RMW CMA RF daily, percent

macro.source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
macro.terms: Public series; cite FRED and the original source

NFCI.description: Chicago Fed national financial conditions index

prices.terms: Unofficial endpoint; personal research use; restated after splits
prices.layout: prices/<SYMBOL>/<YEAR>.csv.gz (split-adjusted OHLC, volume) and events.csv.gz (dividends, splits)

recession_model.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, yield-curve recession model
recession_model.note: Rows dated up to 12 months after the last spread hold the model's forecast for that month.

universe.terms: CC BY-SA; secondary source, current members only
universe.layout: universe/sp500-constituents.csv.gz; survivors only, no removed companies

valuation.layout: valuation/shiller-monthly.csv.gz; recent months contain Shiller's own estimates
valuation.note: The public file ends where Shiller last updated it; it is not extended here.

revision: current revision downloaded at observed_at; not an original vintage
purpose: Research history in its current revision; never an input of the point-in-time engine snapshot.
